description.p: This is a community package of DeckCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the DeckCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.
DeckCraft is an open-source, native presentation app written in Rust that follows the Microsoft PowerPoint workflow.

ul.li: Themes, layouts, shapes, pictures, tables and charts
Full-screen slide show with a presenter view
Every command can be driven by AI agents

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=deckcraft-cli ai.storyteller.deckcraft --help

Permissions: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, sound playback, and the Documents folder. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.deckcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.deckcraft
